contexts.text: In man there is nothing but what is filthy. AC 1864.
The filthy Jerusalem. Described.
The love of self... is what is most filthy of all things... AC 2057.
Mutual love... consists in... acknowledging and believing that itself is... a somewhat vile and filthy...
These evil and subtle Spirits attach their ideas to filthy objects and things; and therein represent to themselves filthy things...
In humiliation of heart there is the acknowledgement that self is nothing but what is filthy...
Under Christian, see this reference.
Their thoughts were so filthy and obscene...
Their phantasies are attached to filthy and obscene objects...
These delights are then seen to be relatively vile; nay, filthy.
With (such) what is holy is not holy, but... is either filthy or profane.

The uses of the organs of generation are hidden... lest they should be injured by filthy thoughts, which are those of lasciviousness, whoredom, and adultery; and which thoughts are excited in most people when these organs are merely mentioned.
Good then flows through... into the Sensuous, and is there... changed into what is filthy...
Spirits of this character came to me, and brought with them filthy thoughts, from which flowed filthy discourse...
Inwardly they are filthy, because they are in the love of self...

There are others who in the life of the body have been most filthy... By their presence and influx into the solid parts of the body they induce weariness of life, and such a torpor of the members and joints, that the man can scarcely rise from his bed.

I observed that whenever I sank down into this sensuous lumen... filthy and defiled things presented themselves. The reason is that this lumen dominates in the Hells, and through it the Hells chiefly flow into man... Hence it is that misers, adulterers, pleasure seekers, and idlers think filthy things. SE 4627:5.
When a man is elevated towards interior things, he comes... into a milder lumen, and is then withdrawn from the influx of scandalous and filthy things.
Fire, and flame = filthy loves; as the loves of revenge, of cruelty, of hatred, of adultery.
Under Foreskin, see this reference.
Defiled and filthy things... from the life in world, adhere to man after death...
That infernal filthiness would flow in (if infernal Spirits were near those who are in Divine worship). Signified. AC 7456, Explained.
(In Mars) they believe that there is nothing in them but what is filthy and infernal.
That the filthy and defiled things of cupidities... should be excited (in the infesters). Signified. These things are excited when the Divine truth flows in, and Heaven approaches nearer.
A sore = the filthy things which are from evils.
It bred worms = that what is filthy came from it.
The filth of falsity is compared to a worm in .
Lest the interior things of love, which are filthy and infernal, should appear. Signified.
To commit adultery means to think filthy things...
They who have accustomed themselves to speak filthy and obscene things... SE 3125.
Filthy delights...
They turn everything into what is filthy.
He supposes that the Lord alone is filthy, because He has taken away all the filthiness from the human race...
The quality of these filthy loves was shown me; how they confirm such things by filthy reasonings...
(They professed) that there is nothing in them but what is filthy.
How filthy ideas punish those who entertain them.
They are among the most filthy... SE 4367.
Filthy ideas are at once suggested to them...
Lest filthy loves should appear. Signified.
These loves are filthy loves because all evils flow from them...
They had accounted filthy thoughts as wicked.
(Thus) filthy affections and thoughts completely close both Heavens.
